Name: (CP) Grounded Lightning Rods
Author: Korporate
Description:
[color=#ffffff][b][size=4]Grounded Lightning Rods
[/size][/b]by Korporate

[b][size=4]What it does:
[/size][/b]Changes the crafting recipe for lightning rods from 1 iron bar, 1 refined quartz, and 5 bat wings to 5 copper bars, 5 iron bars, and 1 refined quartz.

[b][size=4]Requirements:
[/size][/b]Stardew Valley 1.6
SMAPI 4.0.0
Content Patcher 2.9.1

[b][size=4]Notes:
[/size][/b]A more grounded recipe – copper wire is a better conductor than bat wings.[/color]
